notes: Only 7 tasks in the whole 56k pool mention HuggingFace at all, so domain-5 matches are essentially limited to the three huggingface/transformers Rebench issues. Recursive-Task-Synthesis shortlist was almost pure boilerplate overlap on the word 'dataset' (dtool/btoep dataset-creation chores, AES encryption) - all discarded; the CADE embedding family and the EQL counting family were found by my own searches and are the real RTS signal. TerminalWorld and RTS share near-duplicate seeds (EQL/counts.json, CADE, dtool), so several picks across those two corpora are siblings; merge should expect that. SWE-Smith has no dataset/tokenizer-pipeline tasks at all - fvcore counting and string2string NLP metrics are the honest best, and their overall scores say so.
